_note: Read 17 Sep 2026. Recorded on the canonical host sobharealty.com (www 301-redirects). Originals used, not the /styles/webp/ derivatives. Filenames are mostly meaningless ('Mask Group 15263'), so every image was downloaded and looked at. Excluded after looking: 'Mask Group 15255' and 'Mask Group 15269' - both are the same lifestyle cut-out of two women at a cafe table with faded edges, a marketing graphic not a building; '350x483.jpg' is a 350px crop, under the 600px floor; 'Mask Group 15078' is a tall mobile crop of 'Mask Group 15060'. Brochure download asks for name and phone - not fetched.
